Thanks for confirming, Megan — we’ll prioritize the dashboards and thresholds. I pulled together a short mapping and included recommendations below.

Quick mapping (high level):
- P0 (service unavailable / model not responding): alert on 5xx rate > 1% over 2m and cluster availability < 99.5%
- P1 (degraded latency): 95th percentile latency > 800ms for 2m with sustained increase over 5m
- P1 (high token failure): token-level error spikes (auth errors / rate-limit hits) > 0.5%

Dashboard panels to call out in the handoff:
- Serving health: pod/instance status, GPU memory pressure, queue depth
- Latency heatmap: by route + model variant (critical for canary analysis)
- Token error taxonomy view: classification by error type (auth, decode, kernel OOM, rate-limit)

I’ve attached a short runbook extract with example alert actions (page 2) and a one-page checklist. We’ll also demo tracing hooks during the meeting so EngOps can see the end-to-end request path.

See you Thu 11:00 PT. Join link: https://meet.redwood.ai/ops-handoff-atlas

-Aditya
